title: Data Extraction Activity Report
description: Bulk export and extraction activity through RMAN, Data Pump, and direct-path APIs.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Audit Type' in ('RMAN','DATAPUMP','DIRECT_PATH_API') | stats count as Events by 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Audit Type', 'Operation Status' | sort -Events | head 100
